about_the_game:
Key Features:

  • Free-to-play online multiplayer autobattler.

  • Ranked system.

  • Four heroes with 7 signature spells.

  • 90+ playable spells.

  • 35+ unique items.

  • 30+ challenging creatures.

  • 4-slot spell bar where sequencing determines victory.

  • Timed, parallel phases - no downtime, constant decisions.

  • PvE encounters with progression and loot rewards.

  • PvP duels with drafting.

Outthink, outlast, outplay.

Do you risk mana in early PvP duels, or conserve it for later rounds? Push PvE for rare loot, or take a safer approach to recover and prepare? With tiered spells, limited resources, and timed parallel phases, every decision counts. Only one hero will stand at the end.

Shape your hero and playstyle.

Each hero has 7 unique spells, and you can customize your playstyle by selecting 5 supporting spells before the match. Discover and learn spells as you go, with each spell offering 3 upgrade tiers to refine your strategy and create powerful combos.

Phases that keep the pressure on.

Every round is played in timed, parallel phases, so all players make decisions at the same time:

  • Spell Draft – Discover new spells from your personalized pool.

  • PvE Encounters – Battle monsters for loot. Winning pushes you toward stronger enemies with better rewards, while losing sets you back to easier foes with smaller loot.

  • PvP Duels – Before each duel, you and your opponent draft spells for the fight. Once the draft is complete, the duel plays out automatically using your 4-slot spell bar. Each duel also has optional win conditions for bonus rewards, introducing mindgames.

  • Night Phase – Spend the night boosting your hero’s stats: Power, Critical strike, Stamina, and Intelligence. Review your opponents’ progress and plan carefully to gain an edge in the next cycle.

Wishlist now — it’s free.

The wishlist button is right above this description. If you enjoy fast decision-making, clever spell combos, and outplaying opponents with pure strategy, add the game to your wishlist to get notified the moment we launch.
